slides.summary: This slide performs a competitive landscape analysis, positioning the startup's product as a superior, cost-effective alternative to traditional banks and legacy currency exchange services. It utilizes a feature-comparison matrix to demonstrate how the platform uniquely solves the full cycle of customer pain points compared to incumbents like Revolut, WeSwap, Worldremit, and FairFX.
key_points: Competitive positioning maps Banks, Travelex, and FairFX as difficult and expensive against Revolut, WeSwap, and Worldremit as easy and cost-effective.
Feature comparison highlights user needs such as convenient cash/card use, instant transfers without IBANs, and real-time exchange rates.
The slide claims the company's product is the only solution that addresses the full cycle of identified customer pain points.
Competitors listed: BANK, Travelex Currency Exchange, FairFX, worldremit, WeSwap, Revolut.

slides.summary: This slide presents a five-year financial projection model for a fintech card product, detailing customer acquisition, revenue streams, direct and operating expenses, and net profitability. It outlines a path to profitability by year 3 and includes an explicit capital requirement to support these growth targets.
key_points: Projected growth from 20,000 to 420,000 total customers over five years.
Forecasts reaching net profitability of £1,244,350 by Year 3.
Total revenue is expected to scale from £690,000 in Year 1 to £17,010,000 in Year 5.
Gross profit margins show significant expansion from £228,350 to £12,628,350.
The company is seeking £1.5m in funding to execute the projected plan.
